blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After Sen. Mark Villar’s transfer to the Senate majority last week, no other senator has yet informed the minority bloc of planning to cross over the political fence, according to Sen. Robinhood Padilla. But if any of his colleagues in the minority should decide to follow Villar’s move, he said the group will not take it against them. “No one has informed us of any plans to leave, I hope no one does. But we won’t get upset [if they do decide to do it],” Padilla said in an interview with radio dzBB on Sunday. “In fact, we […]...
